datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Mozambique on a monthly basis throughout 2015. The classifications represent spatial assessments of acute food insecurity phases, which are typically triggered by drought and other hazards affecting food availability and access. The data was compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON and KML formats) with temporal coverage for January, April, July, and October 2015.
